upstreams.name: concordia
upstreams.installation_method: editable install from the pinned local checkout (/home/user/concordia); reproducible alternative: pip install git+https://github.com/fnstggl/concordia@<pinned_commit_sha>
upstreams.integrity: installed editable from the checkout at the pinned SHA; upstream source unmodified (git status clean at install; verified by gate A integrity check against the pinned checkout)
known_issues: fork HEAD adds ScriptedByEntityModel which breaks no-arg prefab enumeration used by examples/ tests (20 examples-only failures; core library green). We never enumerate prefabs package-wide.

upstreams.name: agentsociety2
upstreams.installation_method: editable install from the pinned local checkout subdirectory (/home/user/agentsociety2/packages/agentsociety2); reproducible alternative: pip install 'git+https://github.com/fnstggl/agentsociety2@<pinned_commit_sha>#subdirectory=packages/agentsociety2'
upstreams.integrity: installed editable from the checkout at the pinned SHA; upstream source unmodified
environment_pins: mcp>=1.13.1,<2  (upstream's floating lower bound resolves to mcp 2.x, which removed mcp.server.fastmcp and breaks import; the pin preserves upstream source unchanged)
known_issues: import agentsociety2 requires AGENTSOCIETY_LLM_API_KEY set at module import (dummy value is sufficient for offline use)
